# Lighting capability and evidence record

<!-- Generated by tools/render_capability_record.js from server/lighting-capabilities.js. Edit the data module, then regenerate. -->

Record version 1.0.0, recorded 2026-10-29. Inspected base: 568896f (main, 2.3.0) plus the reference-lighting branch.

KeyShot Studio 2026.2 EDU scripting (live GUI only; headless scripting is unavailable on this license).

**Authority.** Capability statements in docs/LIGHTING_AND_MOOD_DEEP_DIVE.md and docs/PHOTO_WORKFLOW.md where they disagree with this record; those files remain as dated history. [Measured refinement](MEASURED_REFINEMENT.md) and the code are the authority for the acceptance loop. Nothing here is a similarity percentage or a claim of arbitrary 1:1 photograph matching.

## Evidence labels

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `source-confirmed` | Behavior exists in the inspected source and is covered by offline tests; actual renderer behavior may still differ. |
| `recorded-live-evidence` | A controlled KeyShot experiment was recorded in the existing project documentation; it was not rerun for this record. |
| `documented` | Official external KeyShot documentation describes it; not verified on the installed 2026.2 build. |
| `proposed` | An engineering proposal or an offline-only result (including the synthetic renderer); not a demonstrated KeyShot result. |
| `open` | Insufficient evidence; a version-specific live check is required. |

## Controls added or clarified in this record

| Id | Capability | Evidence | Where | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `control.power_mode` | Power mode recorded in every recipe (artistic or physical) | `source-confirmed` | server/light-spec.js; photo recipe.power_mode | Artistic (default, unchanged): non-IES flux = E * gain * distance^2 * rig exposure. Physical: flux = E * gain * (3 spans * source scale)^2, independent of distance and rig exposure. Live equal-flux check: E02. |
| `control.exposure` | studio.exposure is a rig multiplier, not sensor exposure | `source-confirmed` | server/light-spec.js | Multiplies artistic flux and the IES multiplier; ignored in physical mode. Renderer exposure and image style are separate and not controlled here. |
| `control.per_light_aim` | Per-light aim offset (target_offset, product spans) | `source-confirmed` | server/photo.js cleanTargetOffset; server/light-spec.js aimPoint | Bridge already accepted a per-spec target; photo plans can now set one per source. Named-part targets are not implemented. Live mixed-target check: E01/E02. |
| `control.visibility_intent` | Explicit emitter visibility intent | `source-confirmed` | server/photo.js cleanVisibility | Applied to Area sources only because the bridge writes the three flags only for Area; other types keep defaults and the plan reports the difference. |
| `control.source_limits` | One to six sources, shared product-scaled framing | `source-confirmed` | server/photo.js cleanPlan; lightingFrame | Source count, identity and type are locked during refinement. |

## Recovery and ownership

| Id | Capability | Evidence | Where | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recovery.session_undo` | One-level session undo (camera checkpoint, hidden originals, environment restore) | `source-confirmed` | server/photo.js; server/server.js restore | Existing behavior, fixture-tested. Live restoration checks exist only as the opt-in tools/test_photo_live.js. |
| `recovery.receipts` | Persistent job receipt (identity, initial state, owned items, last accepted recipe, operation receipts, restore status) | `source-confirmed` | server/job-receipt.js; server/photo.js recovery() | Written before the first scene change; ownership comes only from recorded items; restore requires the recorded scene identity. Restart behavior against a real scene is untested. E14. |
| `recovery.node_ids` | Native node ids in receipts | `open` | bridge op_light_set | The bridge tracks created node ids but does not return them; receipts currently record light ids and materials. |
| `recovery.direct_removal` | Direct removal of imported light carriers | `recorded-live-evidence` | bridge op_light_remove | KeyShot retained the carrier mesh after node deletion in the disposable scene; broad cleanup is refused. Saved-checkpoint reopening is a disposable-scene reset only. E01. |

## Measurement and comparison

| Id | Capability | Evidence | Where | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `measure.passes` | Clown, Beauty and single-level tiled ZIP EXR passes | `recorded-live-evidence` | server/lighting-evidence.js; server/exr.js | Render passes and Clown masks recorded as live-proven on the disposable scene; other EXR layouts are refused. |
| `measure.shared_mask` | One mask applied to the reference and the render | `source-confirmed` | server/image-mask.js; photo-refinement referenceMetrics; lighting-evidence masked_beauty | Replaces the asymmetry between all-pixel reference statistics and Clown-product render statistics. Correspondence assumes the camera is aligned (E05); manual polygon/rect masks only, no automatic segmentation. E06. |

| `measure.repeat_noise` | Repeat noise distributions per metric | `open` | server/photo-refinement.js decision | Current gate uses a single repeat difference; distributions are not measured on a real scene. E04. |
| `measure.camera_alignment` | Camera alignment helper (landmarks, silhouette overlay, reprojection check) | `proposed` | server/camera-alignment.js | Validated on injected fixtures only; KeyShot projection conventions against a rendered calibration target are untested. Not wired into the app. E05. |

## Search and reconstruction

| Id | Capability | Evidence | Where | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `search.vision_loop` | Bounded vision refinement (default 2 attempts, 12 captures, 480 s) | `source-confirmed` | server/photo.js; server/photo-refinement.js | Accepts a candidate only when the named objective improves by more than max(0.005, 2x repeat difference). A heuristic, not a similarity percentage. |
| `search.objectives` | Multi-component objective (highlight shapes, shadow direction, regional tone/colour, sharpness) | `proposed` | server/lighting-objectives.js | Adversarial-fixture tests on synthetic images only; not wired into the app. E07. |
| `search.optimizer` | Coordinate and Powell-style derivative-free search with repeat-noise gating | `proposed` | server/derivative-free.js; tools/reconstruction_harness.js | Compared with the existing director loop at equal render budget on a synthetic renderer with a stand-in vision policy (see docs/RELEASE_NOTES_REFERENCE_LIGHTING.md for the table). Coordinate search beat the stand-in; the Powell-style variant did worse than coordinate search. Not wired into the app. E07, E13. |
| `search.light_basis` | Light-response basis (NNLS over per-source linear renders) | `proposed` | server/light-basis.js | Synthetic renderer only; tone mapping and clipping break it by construction. E09. |

## Research experiments

Offline results never close an experiment. Each stays open until the live column says otherwise.

| Id | Question | Offline coverage | Live KeyShot status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **E01** | Replay the four source families on a saved disposable scene | none | open |
| **E02** | Change each parameter independently; measure response and unit/mode semantics (including the physical power mode) | power-model and spec unit tests | open |
| **E03** | IES gain reaches the native multiplier | plan -> spec -> bridge parameter trace (tools/test_light_spec.js) | open: plan -> readback -> render round trip |
| **E04** | Capture noise and image transforms are stable | colour contract and noise estimator unit tests | open |
| **E05** | A known camera can be recovered from landmarks/silhouette | injected-fixture projection and pose-recovery tests | open: rendered calibration target |
| **E06** | Matching masks improve ranking | symmetric-mask tests on synthetic images | open: ground-truth masks on real products |
| **E07** | Numerical fitting beats the present refinement at equal budget | synthetic-renderer comparison (tools/test_reconstruction.js) | open: same-renderer KeyShot cases and blinded preference |
| **E08** | Native Planar can be constructed and restored | none | open |
| **E09** | Light-response fitting predicts combined renders | synthetic NNLS with held-out mixtures | open |
| **E10** | Structural source changes help at equal budget | none | open |
| **E11** | IES distributions are correctly aimed and ranked | none | open |
| **E12** | Flags/cards are required for residuals | none | open |
| **E13** | Which optimizer buys the most quality per capture | coordinate vs Powell on the synthetic renderer (tools/run_reconstruction_comparison.js) | open |
| **E14** | Jobs recover after restart or failure | receipt store and director restart simulation (tools/test_job_receipt.js) | open: interrupt between each operation class on a disposable scene |
| **E15** | Real photographs match after alignment | none | open |
| **E16** | Multi-view evidence improves consistency | none | open |
